post.description: Open (or manually resume after a config-loss stop) the registration gate. Succeeds only when at least one protection (email or bot) is verified; clears the stop latch. NOTE: E15a is the control plane only. Until the Kratos enforcement unit (E15d) is connected, opening, closing or overriding the gate does NOT block or allow real Kratos registrations; real registration is not protected yet.

422.description: Minimum protection condition not met, or already open

post.description: Open the registration gate with override: allowed even without a verified protection, but only after the warning is explicitly acknowledged. Stays in effect until explicitly revoked; automatic stop and outage rejection are not applied while it is active (verified protections are still enforced). NOTE: E15a is the control plane only. Until the Kratos enforcement unit (E15d) is connected, opening, closing or overriding the gate does NOT block or allow real Kratos registrations; real registration is not protected yet.

400.description: Invalid request or warning not acknowledged

post.description: Revoke the override and return to normal judgement, re-evaluated against the current observation. Never closes the gate by itself. NOTE: E15a is the control plane only. Until the Kratos enforcement unit (E15d) is connected, opening, closing or overriding the gate does NOT block or allow real Kratos registrations; real registration is not protected yet.
